1. (Currently amended) A method comprising: a processor performing the steps of determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; accessing a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; receiving an indication from the data store that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication with respect to at least one of the payment transactions; accepting the received indication as proof-of-life with respect to the recipient; and making the benefit payment to the recipient in response to said proof-of-life, wherein the method includes at least one additional technological step beyond the abstract idea of authenticating a recipient and making a payment, comprising: verifying that the biometric user authentication was performed by the recipient using a specific technological device or system that is distinct from the payment transaction itself.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said at least one payment transaction occurred during a pre-determined period of time prior to said accessing step, and wherein the processor verifies the time interval between the biometric authentication and the accessing step.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 2, wherein said pre-determined period of time is seven days.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 2, wherein said pre-determined period of time is 24 hours.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment and wherein the processor accesses a government database to confirm the recipient's eligibility status.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the at least one of the payment transactions includes a credit card account transaction and/or a debit card account transaction, and wherein the processor retrieves biometric authentication records from a payment processor's secure database.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6, wherein a mobile device was used by the recipient to initiate the at least one payment transaction, and wherein the processor verifies that the mobile device's biometric authentication system was engaged.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is made via an electronic monetary transfer to an account owned by the recipient, and wherein the processor executes the transfer through a secure banking network.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is made by sending a check to the recipient, and wherein the processor generates and transmits check issuance instructions to a financial institution.

10. (Currently amended) A method comprising: a processor performing the steps of determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; accessing, at a first point in time, a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; determining that the data store contains an indication that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication most recently with respect to one of said payment transactions at a second point in time earlier than the first point in time; comparing a time interval defined by the second and first points in time with a pre-determined permissive time interval; making the benefit payment, without requiring proof-of-life authentication of the recipient, in a case where the time interval defined by the second and first points in time does not exceed the pre-determined permissive time interval; and requiring proof-of-life authentication of the recipient, prior to making the benefit payment, in a case where the time interval defined by the second and first points in time exceeds the pre-determined permissive time interval, wherein the method includes at least one additional technological step beyond the abstract idea of authenticating a recipient and making a payment, comprising: automatically retrieving and comparing biometric authentication timestamps from a secure database system that is technologically distinct from the payment transaction system itself.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the pre-determined permissive time interval is seven days, and wherein the processor automatically calculates the time interval using system timestamps.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the pre-determined permissive time interval is 24 hours, and wherein the processor automatically calculates the time interval using system timestamps.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment and wherein the processor accesses a government database to confirm the recipient's eligibility status.

14. (Currently amended) An apparatus comprising: a processor; and a memory in communication with the processor, the memory storing program instructions, the processor operative with the program instructions to perform functions as follows: determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; accessing a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; receiving an indication from the data store that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication with respect to at least one of the payment transactions; accepting the received indication as proof-of-life with respect to the recipient; and making the benefit payment to the recipient in response to said proof-of-life, wherein the apparatus includes at least one additional technological component beyond abstract authentication and payment processing, comprising: a biometric authentication verification module that is technologically distinct from the payment transaction processing module.

15. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein said at least one payment transaction occurred during a pre-determined period of time prior to said accessing, and wherein the processor includes a timestamp verification module.

16. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 15, wherein said pre-determined period of time is seven days.

17. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 15, wherein said pre-determined period of time is 24 hours.

18. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment and wherein the apparatus includes a government database interface module.

19. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein the at least one of the payment transactions includes a credit card account transaction and/or a debit card account transaction, and wherein the apparatus includes a payment processor database interface module.

20. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 19, wherein a mobile device was used by the recipient to initiate the at least one payment transaction, and wherein the apparatus includes a mobile device biometric verification module.
